balloons.text: Eleventh round complete.
Good luck, Aren.
I am Neris. I assess controlled transfers and supervise today’s upper couriers.
No fee. One bell of your time. A pass qualifies you for supervised light-transfer work.
ArenI have one bell.
Stay inside the blue mark. Wait for his invitation before the handover.
A light wooden practice weight. No customer mail.
NerisIf your footing, line or landing is wrong, do not launch. Call a reset.
I kept thinking I would have to make it look easy.
I need someone I can keep working beside. Show me that.
One moment.
Here. I can take it now.
You stopped inside the mark. Then you left him time to finish.
Was that enough?
NerisFor the work we tested. You passed.
Controlled transfer. Supervised light work. It is entered.
I can authorize one carry with me now. It is optional.
West sorting desk, by the corridor with me. One letter, another quarter bell.
NerisThree coppers for this carry, paid at West desk.
I have the quarter bell. I will take that one.
Aren is cleared for this assignment, under my supervision. West desk.
I have looked at these windows from below.
NerisThey leak from this side too.
The intake letter? Here, please.
West desk. Received.
NerisThat is the whole carry.
Three coppers, as agreed.
I want to remember this.
SeraThen take a moment.
I have two more desks. You are finished for today.
I would like another assignment.
NerisBring your available hours next time. We will see what needs doing.
